twin_model.primitives.scheduler

Scheduler primitive for production order management.

This module provides a scheduler primitive that manages production orders, product changeovers, shift schedules, and maintenance windows. It coordinates the timing and sequencing of production activities.

class twin_model.primitives.scheduler.SchedulerPrimitive(env, config)[source]

Bases: twin_model.primitives.base.BasePrimitive

Scheduler for coordinating production activities.

Emits observables for: - Order scheduling and completion - Changeover events - Shift transitions - Schedule adherence metrics - Order tardiness - Resource conflicts
